## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Hetuduka, Vedanāttika* is a text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. It forms part of the extensive combinatory framework in which dyads (*duka*) are systematically correlated with triads (*tika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. Specifically, it represents the analytical section where the first dyad—the root dyad (*hetuduka*)—is cross-tabulated with the feeling triad (*vedanāttika*), proceeding through the standard permutation schemes that couple each dyad with all twenty-two triads of the Abhidhamma matrix [Nyanatiloka 2007].

**Sources**

- [Nyanatiloka 2007] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Piṭaka (1938, 1957, 2007) — Described the combinatorial structure of the Hetuduka combined with the 22 triads, specifically Hetu-duka-vedanā-ttika.
